title: Error Explainer
summary: Turns a raw error code into what happened, the likely cause and one next step, and warns when a timed-out payment may already have gone through.
description: Says what happened, the likely cause and one next step, waits out Retry-After, warns that an ambiguous timeout on a payment may already have gone through with Check status before Retry, and gives a copyable support reference with technical details tucked away.
catches: Raw codes with no explanation, mapped through your catalog
Retrying a non-idempotent request after an ambiguous timeout (offers Check status first)
Errors that keep failing, with a contact option after maxRetries
limits: Explanations come from the catalog or explanation you pass
Whether a retry is safe depends on the `idempotent` flag you set
a11y: The error is announced with role="alert"
Waiting and status changes are aria-live="polite"
Actions are buttons with visible text; icons are aria-hidden
server: Make retried operations idempotent on the server and expose a status endpoint for ambiguous outcomes.
stops: Paid twice after a payment timeout error
